ledger-sources-typed.jsonl.rule: Each source and its record gain unavailable_class and operand, inserted right after verdict; nothing else changes. matched and diverged: null and null. A dbt inputs-not-equalized row whose reason is hermit's dbt declaration (parity_ledger.INPUTS_NOT_EQUALIZABLE['dbt']): inputs-not-equalized and candidate. A candidate-missing row whose reason is 'the <backend> candidate verify cell of <test_id> has no result row in this run': no-result-row and candidate. Any other row has no rule and the derivation fails. Lines are json.dumps(value, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) plus a newline, which re-encodes every line of ledger-sources.jsonl byte for byte.
ledger-sources-typed.jsonl.why: RUN 1953 predates the typed unavailable_class and operand fields of parity-ledger/v1 (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3301), so its verbatim export has neither and the ledger refuses it. The run has only two unmeasured shapes, 14 dbt inputs-not-equalized rows and 3 candidate rows with no result row, and the typed contract of that issue fixes the class of each: an inputs-not-equalized verdict has class inputs-not-equalized, and a missing result row has class no-result-row with the side that lacks it as operand. The rows' verdicts, reasons, records and credits are the run's own. Replace this file with a verbatim typed export once hermit's typed producer is on main.
